title: APIs
desc: APIs, or Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients, are the components in a pharmaceutical drug that produce the intended therapeutic effect. Our portfolio spans 55 commercial APIs manufactured under stringent quality systems for global pharmaceutical companies.

title: Under Development APIs
desc: Under-development APIs are driven by pharmaceutical innovation, enabling us to meet dynamic healthcare demands and emerging treatment challenges.

title: Intermediates
desc: Pharmaceutical intermediates serve as building blocks used during API production. They are used solely in the synthesis of APIs and are not directly administered to patients.

title: Under Development Intermediates
desc: Advanced key starting materials and regulatory intermediates under process development to support upcoming API launches and custom synthesis programs.

title: Piperidone & Piperidine Derivatives
desc: Piperidines are among the most important synthetic fragments for designing drugs and play a significant role in the pharmaceutical industry. Cost-effective processes for these derivatives are our core expertise.

title: Pellets & MUPS
desc: Pellets are small, free-flowing, spherical particles made by combining fine powders or granules of drugs and excipients — value-added, semi-finished formulations for novel drug delivery systems.

title: CMO / CDMO
desc: VPCL offers long-term contract manufacturing services — from strategic partnerships in development and validations to DMF filing and commercial manufacturing.
